title: Tame torsor ramification is killed by the group-order root over a DVR
statement: Let B be a discrete valuation ring (a nonfield local principal ideal domain) with uniformizer pi, K=Frac(B), a finite group G of order n invertible in B, and a finite etale G-torsor T->Spec K [def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois]. Set A=B[t]/(t^n-pi), q:Spec A->Spec B, j:Spec K->Spec B, and a=pullback.snd(T.pi followed by j,q). Assume a quasi-compact and quasi-separated, and its relative normalization [lem-weil-pbc-relative-normalization] finite over Spec A. At any point x of this normalization lying over (t), the maximal ideal of its stalk is generated by the structural image of the explicit root t. This is only the index-one calculation over a DVR; there is no ambient chart, arbitrary Noetherian H, or assertion of nonmembership in the square.

proof.text: Decompose the finite torsor over K into finite Galois field components whose degrees divide |G|, retaining an isomorphism over Spec K.
Apply the component-wise DVR root calculation with n=|G|>0. This gives m <= (tau)+m*m at x, independently of the finite-normalization hypothesis.

A DVR is Noetherian and its polynomial quotient A is Noetherian. Finiteness of a.fromNormalization gives a locally Noetherian normalization and a Noetherian stalk C. Its maximal ideal m is finitely generated. Apply Submodule.le_of_le_smul_of_le_jacobson_bot with I=m, N=(tau), Nprime=m, using maximalIdeal_le_jacobson, to deduce m <= (tau).

The base stalk is the localization of A at the prime a.fromNormalization(x). IsLocalization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal and the prime hypothesis identify its maximal ideal with the span of the root germ. The structural stalk map is local, so tau belongs to m. Ideal.span_le gives (tau) <= m. Antisymmetry finishes the exact stated equality.

lean.statement:
theorem dvr_root_normalization_maximalIdeal
    (B : CommRingCat.{u}) [IsDomain B] [IsDiscreteValuationRing B]
    (pi : B) (hpi : Irreducible pi)
    (G : Type (u + 1)) [Group G] [Finite G]
    (T : GaloisCover G (Spec (CommRingCat.of (FractionRing B))))
    (hn : IsUnit (Nat.card G : B)) :
    let A := AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial B) ^ Nat.card G - Polynomial.C pi)
    let N := Spec (CommRingCat.of A)
    let q := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B A))
    let j := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B (FractionRing B)))
    let a := pullback.snd (T.π ≫ j) q
    ∀ (hqc : QuasiCompact a) (hqs : QuasiSeparated a),
    letI := hqc
    letI := hqs
    IsFinite a.fromNormalization →
    ∀ (x : a.normalization),
      (a.fromNormalization x).asIdeal = Ideal.span
        {AdjoinRoot.root ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial B) ^ Nat.card G - Polynomial.C pi)} →
      let C := a.normalization.presheaf.stalk x
      let tau := (a.fromNormalization.stalkMap x).hom
        (AlgebraicGeometry.StructureSheaf.toStalk A (a.fromNormalization x)
          (AdjoinRoot.root ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial B) ^ Nat.card G - Polynomial.C pi)))
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal C = Ideal.span {tau}
